mode: Registry metadata only; no package tarballs or install scripts

scripts.test: npm run test:typescript && npm run lint:eslint && npm run test:vitest
scripts.dev:build: npm run build && node ./dist/cli/cli.js source build --noUsageExample
scripts.dev:setup: npm run build && node ./dist/cli/cli.js source download --noUsageExample && npm run docs:generateTypedoc && npm run dev:setup:downloadAllTestModels
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generateTypedoc && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" vitepress build

scripts.build: rimraf dist && webpack --config scripts/webpack.config.prod.js && rollup -c scripts/rollup.esm.mjs
pnpm run lint && rollup -c rollup.config.ts --configPlugin typescript
premove dist && pnpm build-bundle && pnpm build-types
scripts.typecheck: tsc && tsc -p src/node && tsc -p src/module-runner && tsc -p src/shared && tsc -p src/node/__tests_dts__

scripts.build: npm run build:compiler && npm run build:tests

scripts.tsc:all: npm run tsc && npm run tsc:test
scripts.pw:install: npx cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_GC=1 npx playwright install chromium

scripts.test:pnpm: cd tests/pnpm && node check.js && pnpm install && pnpm exec tsc
scripts.test:types:all: npm run test:types && npm run test:types:5.3 && npm run test:types:5.x && npm run test:types:7.x

scripts.postpack: git restore package.json bin src types configs
scripts.depcruise: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --ignore-known
scripts.test:glob: set -f && test "`bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs --no-config test/extract/__mocks__/gather-globbing/packages/**/src/**/*.js | grep "no dependency violations found"`" = "✔ no dependency violations found (6 modules, 0 dependencies cruised)"
scripts.test:load: hyperfine --warmup 3 --runs 30 "bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --ignore-known --no-cache --no-progress"
scripts.lint:eslint: oxlint bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs bin src test configs tools/**/*.mjs
scripts.depcruise:all: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools
scripts.depcruise:focus: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --progress --no-cache --output-type text --focus
scripts.lint:eslint:fix: oxlint bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs bin src test configs tools/**/*.mjs --fix
scripts.test:load:short: hyperfine --warmup 1 --runs 5 "bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --ignore-known --no-cache --no-progress"
scripts.depcruise:report: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types --output-type err-html --config configs/.dependency-cruiser-show-metrics-config.mjs --output-to dependency-violations.html
scripts.test:load:cached: hyperfine --warmup 3 --runs 30 "bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --ignore-known --cache node_modules/.cache/dependency-cruiser/load-cached --no-progress"
scripts.depcruise:explain: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --output-type err-long --progress none
scripts.depcruise:reaches: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --progress --no-cache --config configs/.dependency-cruiser-unlimited.mjs --output-type text --reaches
scripts.depcruise:baseline: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --baseline --progress
scripts.update-dependencies: npm-run-all --node-run upem:update upem:install build:clean build lint:eslint:clear-caches lint:fix depcruise test:cover
scripts.depcruise:graph:view: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs bin src --prefix vscode://file/$(pwd)/ --config configs/.dependency-cruiser-show-metrics-config.mjs --output-type dot-webpage --progress cli-feedback --highlight "$(watskeburt main)" | browser
scripts.depcruise:report:view: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types --output-type err-html --config configs/.dependency-cruiser-show-metrics-config.mjs --output-to - | browser
scripts.prepack:clean-pkg-json: clean-pkg-json --dry | jq '.scripts = {test: "echo see github for test, build and analysis scripts"}' | jq '.type = "module"' > smaller-package.json && mv smaller-package.json package.json && prettier --log-level warn --write --use-tabs package.json
scripts.test:load:cached:short: hyperfine --warmup 1 --runs 5 "bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs src bin test configs types tools --ignore-known --cache node_modules/.cache/dependency-cruiser/load-cached --no-progress"
scripts.depcruise:graph:doc:json: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs bin src test --output-type json --output-to node_modules/.cache/tmp_graph_deps.json --progress
scripts.depcruise:graph:view:diff: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs bin src test --prefix vscode://file/$(pwd)/ --config configs/.dependency-cruiser-unlimited.mjs --output-type dot-webpage --progress cli-feedback --affected | browser
scripts.depcruise:graph:doc:fmt-dir: ./bin/depcruise-fmt.mjs -T ddot -f - node_modules/.cache/tmp_graph_deps.json | dot -T svg -Grankdir=TD | tee doc/real-world-samples/dependency-cruiser-dir-graph.svg | node bin/wrap-stream-in-html.mjs > docs/dependency-cruiser-dir-graph.html
scripts.depcruise:graph:mermaid:diff: node ./bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs bin src test types tools --config configs/.dependency-cruiser-unlimited.mjs --output-type mermaid --affected $SHA
scripts.prepack:format-src-with-tabs: prettier --log-level warn --write --use-tabs bin src types configs
scripts.depcruise:graph:doc:fmt-archi: ./bin/depcruise-fmt.mjs -T archi -f - node_modules/.cache/tmp_graph_deps.json | dot -T svg -Gordering=in -Grankdir=TD | tee doc/real-world-samples/dependency-cruiser-archi-graph.svg | node bin/wrap-stream-in-html.mjs > docs/dependency-cruiser-archi-graph.html
scripts.depcruise:graph:doc:fmt-types: cd types && node ../bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs . --output-type dot | dot -T svg | tee overview.svg | ../bin/wrap-stream-in-html.mjs > overview.html && cd -
scripts.depcruise:graph:doc:fmt-detail: ./bin/depcruise-fmt.mjs -T dot -f - node_modules/.cache/tmp_graph_deps.json | dot -T svg | tee doc/real-world-samples/dependency-cruiser-without-node_modules.svg | node bin/wrap-stream-in-html.mjs > docs/dependency-cruiser-dependency-graph.html
scripts.depcruise:graph:doc:fmt-schema: cd tools/schema && node ../../bin/dependency-cruiser.mjs . --output-type dot | dot -T svg | tee ../overview.svg | node ../../bin/wrap-stream-in-html.mjs > ../../docs/schema-overview.html && cd -

scripts.test: npm run test:suite && npm run test:readme
npm run test:suite && npm run test:readme
